quarterly_data.quarter: Microchip Technology press release: Microchip Technology Acquires VORAGO Technologies (10-09-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Microchip acquired VORAGO Technologies, a privately held Austin, Texas provider of radiation-hardened and radiation-tolerant microcontrollers (MCUs) and microprocessors (MPUs), adding a rad-hard MCU and MPU family that complements its aerospace and defense product lines plus VORAGO's patented HARDSIL process technology, which Microchip says reduces the design time and cost of new rad-hard products and can enhance the radiation tolerance of existing products without a redesign. Terms were not disclosed and the acquisition is not expected to be material to Microchip's consolidated financial results; Microchip says it is positioned to capture a larger share of the A&D and space markets. CEO Steve Sanghi: the acquisition 'strengthens our ability to support development in these demanding markets.'
quarterly_data.figure: terms not disclosed; not expected to be material to consolidated financial results
